answer: Someone running 196 aliases hence needs 44 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in ridge, expire in spiral, and nectar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 934 identities would post 4360 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
